title: Grid World
description: Reach a per-seed goal on a partially observable grid whose safe region branches, whose hazards are hidden until you are adjacent, and whose turn budget is derived from the seed's own shortest safe route.

metadata.observation_scope: current tile, adjacent tiles, and a bounded 8-turn history window
metadata.hazard_placement: per-seed, never adjacent to the start
metadata.turn_budget: ceil(3/2 * this seed's shortest hazard-free route), capped at the catalog ceiling
